(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((reds (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)) #:when (= (at g r c) 2))
                          (list r c)))
                  (pairs (for*/list ((i (range 0 (length reds))) (j (range (+ i 1) (length reds)))
                             #:when
                             (let ((a (list-ref reds i))
                                   (bb (list-ref reds j)))
                               (or (= (first a) (first bb)) (= (second a) (second bb)))))
                           (list (list-ref reds i) (list-ref reds j))))
                  (trunk-pair (first pairs))
                  (t1 (first trunk-pair))
                  (t2 (second trunk-pair))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (if (= (second t1) (second t2))
                 (let ((tc (second t1))
                       (r1 (min (first t1) (first t2)))
                       (r2 (max (first t1) (first t2))))
                   (for ((r (range (+ r1 1) r2))) (hash-set! result (list r tc) 3))
                   (for ((red reds))
                     (when
                       (and (not (equal? red t1)) (not (equal? red t2)))
                       (let ((rr (first red))
                             (rc (second red)))
                         (if (< rc tc)
                             (for ((cc (range (+ rc 1) tc)))
                               (hash-set! result (list rr cc) 3))
                             (for ((cc (range (+ tc 1) rc)))
                               (hash-set! result (list rr cc) 3)))))))
                 (let ((tr (first t1))
                       (c1 (min (second t1) (second t2)))
                       (c2 (max (second t1) (second t2))))
                   (for ((cc (range (+ c1 1) c2))) (hash-set! result (list tr cc) 3))
                   (for ((red reds))
                     (when
                       (and (not (equal? red t1)) (not (equal? red t2)))
                       (let ((rr (first red))
                             (rc (second red)))
                         (if (< rr tr)
                             (for ((r (range (+ rr 1) tr)))
                               (hash-set! result (list r rc) 3))
                             (for ((r (range (+ tr 1) rr)))
                               (hash-set! result (list r rc) 3))))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
